n = int(input())

line = input()

lineWithoutParantheses = []

numberOfWordsInParantheses = 0
i = 0
while i < len(line):
    if line[i] == '(':
        lineWithoutParantheses.append('_')
        i += 1
        paranthesesWords = []
        while line[i] != ')':
            paranthesesWords.append(line[i])
            i += 1
        wordsInParantheses = ''.join(paranthesesWords).split('_')
        for word in wordsInParantheses:
            if word:
                numberOfWordsInParantheses += 1
    else:
        lineWithoutParantheses.append(line[i])
    i += 1

maxWordWithoutParanthesesLength = 0
wordsWithoutParantheses = ''.join(lineWithoutParantheses).split('_')

for word in wordsWithoutParantheses:
    if word and len(word) > maxWordWithoutParanthesesLength:
        maxWordWithoutParanthesesLength = len(word)

print(f"{maxWordWithoutParanthesesLength} {numberOfWordsInParantheses}")
